parts: CH. AMISTAD SINCERA DE LA KASSYNA
Golden brindle and white female (brindle golden & white) born on May 26, 2000. Shoulder height: 22,50 cm. Weith: 5,800 Kg.
DNA identified with the Real Sociedad Canina de España.

Our start with this breed could not have been better. From the cross of Elisabeth Thailor de la Kassyna with Ice Cream du Val Verdoyant, linebred on the great Ch. Ultra's Who's The Boss, this beautiful girl was born and has been attracting attention since puppyhood.

Her show results say a great deal about her. At two years old, she won CAC, CACIB, Best Female and BOS in Madrid, competing against females from all over Europe under the prestigious judge Mrs. Pamela Cross Stern (Great Britain). Two weeks later, she achieved Excellent 1st, CAC, Best Female, Best of Breed and 3rd in Group in Santander, thus completing her Spanish championship.

She has a lovely outline complemented by a beautiful, strong head with a deep stop, large, full eyes, excellent pigmentation and perfectly aligned teeth, with a slightly undershot bite and barely any muzzle length. Excellent angulation gives her outstanding movement. Incredible coat length and quality (at 10 months her coat already touched the ground).
We are very fortunate to share our lives with this little girl.
